about: Which runners take the pull request build's fallback (build-pr.yml, launcher-vps), which asks for this label alone because it needs nothing of the box. On the box only runner 2 carries it, so runner 1 is kept for main's builds: main's build is what traces the gate map the next pull requests pick their harnesses from (#3114, #3874), and when it waited behind pull request builds it took 49, 75 and 53 minutes from push to done instead of 18 (26 to 27 Oct 2026). Patrick's A on the report page, 27 Oct 2026 (q-4010-main-runner, #4010). Every box runner listed here must also be in records/build-runners.json, so the box's cap still holds (tests/test-2994-build-runners.ps1). offBox names One's runners (Install-Runner.ps1 -OffBox -Number n), which have their own cores and never carry thornswood-vps, so no box job reaches them (Patrick, 26 Oct 2026, #3860). A name listed there with no runner registered under it is named and changes nothing. All five of One's runners take pull request builds again from 30 Oct 2026, now that they are on the Dev Drive R: (#4048, done by Hermes on 29 Oct). On 27 Oct, with all five building on C:, Defender (MsMpEng) was One's biggest process at 2.7 to 3.2 cores while the disk sat at 2% busy, every file read ran 50 to 100 times slower than on the box (the secret scan 5 min 23 s against seconds), and whole-gate builds hit the 40-minute job limit (#3860), so #4089 kept only thornswood-pr-one until the move. On R: the first build ran the whole gate in 15 min 36 s (run 41001165638), a Defender recording showed the scans there moved from opening files to closing them, and thornswood-pr-one's builds took 8 s for the secret scan and 5 min 53 s for a 379-harness gate (run 41010236644). Run-Gate.ps1 counts the names here for this machine, so each of the five takes 4 of One's 22 cores. GitHub's runner labels follow this file on main: a push that changes it runs github-admin.yml, and pwsh scripts/deploy/Set-BuildRunners.ps1 asks again (#3107). Install-Runner.ps1 registers a runner listed here with the label too, so a reinstall keeps it. Moot at the flip, when the box's and One's runners are disabled and GitHub's hosted runners take every build.
